policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Two perfect starts, and eighteen days until it counts.
Ouachita Baptist and Rogers State swept the opening weekend — 6–0 and 4–1 on aggregate. The table stays empty until September 17, when three matches open conference play.
Conference play begins Sep 17. All seven sides are 0–0–0.
3–1–0 points · early form shown from non-conference results · a pre-conference table is a valid state.
Tristan Miller has saved ten of the eleven shots on target he has faced for Rogers State.
One match carries a result whose detail the collector could not reach: Rockhurst against Newman on August 29 has a score and no box score behind it.
Eighteen days of tune-ups before the table means anything.
